preserve: the column map for a file name or *, matched by the start of the lower-case header cell; a table whose first header is not declared, or whose header has a skip word, is not copy
fenced post text of a named file outside skipped sections; consecutive blockquote lines joined into one description; a paragraph file read after its marker line
cut cells dropped, cells stripped and joined, a quoted cell split into its quotes (one curly quote holding nested quotes is one unit), a split cell read as the split kind
a .txt is one unit a line, a .json is strings, { text, kind } rows or a words file; curly apostrophes made straight; the same words in the same judging context are one unit with also_at
allowed_deltas: the person's layouts (their settings row's readers) and the file's text are arguments, so nothing is read from a file beside the code or from disk
dedupe also keys on a unit's field, the name the Workshop readers give the judging field
banned_substitutions: a layout, column name, kind or file name written in the code
judging a split label as a sentence
